hooks.prompt: Block the command if it matches any destructive pattern: rm -rf, git push --force, git push -f, git reset --hard, git clean -fd, git checkout -- ., git branch -D, drop table, truncate, delete from without where, sudo rm, format, mkfs, dd if=. Allow everything else. Return {"permissionDecision":"deny","reason":"<why>"} when blocking, otherwise {"permissionDecision":"allow"}.
